entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Documented "Run a target exactly once" solution not working with Visual Studio #50969
  • [NETSDKE2E] Truncation issue happens on NET 10 RC2 installer UI on the laptop screen (Resolution: 1920x1080). #50968

Closed

  • AXIMP doesn't work correctly with ActiverX exe servers #26190
  • Unhandled Exception: System.Reflection.TargetInvocationException #26183
  • Add a `-t/--target` option to the `build` and `msbuild` commands to make it easier to specify the MSBuild target to execute #26176
  • dotnet workload commands cannot be executed on a remote machine using PowerShell #26156
  • Improved Workload Version Control for NuGets #26130
  • Tab completion does not fully work for `dotnet workload` #26071
  • .NET 8: Make `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk` an implicit reference #25797
  • PublishTrimmed trims too much (Could not load type 'System.Text.Json.JsonSerializer') #10517
    Discussion
  • Ensure dotnet test for MTP doesn't suffer from concurrency issues #50922
  • [MTP dotnet test] Revise TerminalTestReporter handling for discovery mode #50786
    10.0.1xx
  • `dotnet project convert` should fix up relative paths in `#:project` references #50832
    10.0.1xx
  • `dotnet add package` inconsistency with file-based apps #50913
    10.0.1xx
  • Publishing as framework dependent creates self-contained instead when not explicitly disabled #4230
